AI-агент у чаті на Сайті: AI agent in the chat on the Site
Коли ви пишете в чаті першого екрана сво: When you write in the first-screen chat in your own words, an AI agent answers the question. We store the text of the question and the agent’s answer, the language and the page address, the selected niche and the time, as well as a random conversation code and a hash of your IP address (not the address itself) — only to count daily limits. Messages that contain a phone number or a nickname are not sent to the agent: they immediately become a request. Questions the agent could not answer are sent, without your contacts, to the team’s working chat so that we can add to the agent’s knowledge base.
